primary: Per-condition, per-attempted-case number of within-output distinct qualified NEW probe families; 2 maximum
qualifiers: Finite specified matched trials and readout
At least two live rivals predict different observable results
Clear result that defeats the claimed separation/account
Operation beyond ordinary archive and supplied upstream probe operations
equivalence: Same intervention/readout relation and rival discrimination is one family; changed names, order or parameter values alone do not create another. New factorial interaction or different diagnostic readout can qualify only if substantive and not already upstream.

scoring_examples.proposal: repeat existing stronger/weak comparison with same readout
new intervention with different rival predictions, available switch and predeclared disconfirming readout
scoring_examples.reason: qualifies only if absent from archive and upstream

assessors: Two independent native calls per case; raw assessments saved before scoring/display. Each count retained independently; no adjudication replacing first grade.

contrasts.relays: Each factorial cell versus O and G; denominator attempted cases

finite_replay: Coordinator may enumerate exact supplied rival maps and compare actual candidate trial predictions after raw assessments are frozen. Replay is synthetic model arithmetic, not observed real outcomes.
frozen_prerequisite: Case/model packet readable with finite nonempty resource domain and each concern FINAL substantive; if missing, preserve affected original jobs as gated. No performance-based cancellation.
